compliance_rules.label: Notis Mesyuarat (≥15 hari)
compliance_rules.description: Akta Koperasi 1993 Seksyen 17 — Notice of general meeting must be given at least 15 days before the meeting.

compliance_rules.label: Kelayakan Mengundi Ahli Aktif
compliance_rules.description: Akta Koperasi 1993 Seksyen 22(3) — only members in good standing (no arrears) may vote at general meetings.

compliance_rules.label: Kuorum Minimum (≥25%)
compliance_rules.description: GP14 — quorum of not less than 25% of total members must be present for a general meeting to proceed.

compliance_rules.label: Pencadang & Penyokong Usul
compliance_rules.description: GP14B — every motion must have a named proposer and at least one seconder recorded before discussion.

compliance_rules.label: Kekalan Lebih Surplus (≥20%)
compliance_rules.description: GP14B — at least 20% of net surplus must be retained before any distribution to members.

compliance_rules.label: Tempoh Perbahasan (≤15 minit)
compliance_rules.description: UUK Klausa 7.3 — debate on any single motion is limited to 15 minutes before automatic close.

compliance_rules.label: Dividen Minimum 5%
compliance_rules.description: UUK Klausa 8.1 — dividend distributed to members must be at least 5% of distributable surplus.

compliance_rules.label: Rekod Usul Jejakable
compliance_rules.description: BRule-001 — every motion must be recorded with proposer, timestamp and status transitions.

compliance_rules.label: Auto-Gugur Tanpa Penyokong
compliance_rules.description: BRule-003 — a motion without a seconder within 15 minutes is automatically dropped and recorded in the minutes.

compliance_rules.label: Sekatan Tunggakan
compliance_rules.description: BRule-005 — members in share/fee arrears are blocked from voting and from check-in.

compliance_rules.label: Rekod Digital Tidak Boleh Dipadam
compliance_rules.description: Akta Koperasi 1993 Seksyen 24 — cooperative records must be retained; digital records are append-only with a tamper-evident hash chain.
